name: Trigenys Notify
tagline: Multi-product operational notifications with guarded Telegram interactions and approval-based WhatsApp group routing — without turning an accepted message into a delivery promise.
problem: Operational alerts spread across products and messaging applications become duplicated, hard to trace and easy to send to the wrong group. The service needs a shared event contract while each product retains its authorization and retry ownership.
scenario: A Xeption stock alert is recorded in the source outbox, normalized as a versioned tenant event and sent through the explicitly enabled transport to approved staff groups. A Telegram Mini App exposes only authorized staff actions.
differentiation: Source-owned persistent outboxes, per-project allowlists, approved D1 routing and protected Telegram identity bindings prevent discovery from becoming authorization and avoid a competing second sender.
architecture: Xeption source outbox -> versioned Notify event -> Cloudflare Worker tenant policy -> approved D1 group routes -> WAHA transport; separate Telegram Mini App validates signed initData and linked staff authorization.
limitations: WAHA acceptance is not read confirmation or exactly-once delivery. Tenant onboarding remains opt-in; group discovery never grants routing permission. Telegram direct mutations remain feature-flagged and additional product channels require separate integrations.

capabilities.name: Tenant-neutral notification events
capabilities.description: Validate scoped project events with optional channel adapters and source-side retries.

capabilities.name: WAHA group routing
capabilities.description: Discover group candidates and dispatch only along authorized D1 routes.

capabilities.name: Telegram staff Mini App
capabilities.description: Provide signed-session staff views with protected account-linking boundaries.

capabilities.name: Autonomous AI responses
capabilities.description: Explore opt-in AI assistance without granting unreviewed actions or group access.

roadmap.name: Verify production cutover
roadmap.exitCriteria: Demonstrate a controlled single-event WhatsApp dispatch with source outbox receipts and no double send.

roadmap.name: Expand tenant integrations
roadmap.exitCriteria: Prove independent policy isolation and group approval for a second product.
